title: A sidebar extension in the real sidebar: an agent's save redraws it live; cmux ext reload and cmux reload-config reload on request

steps.title: Launch
A workspace whose terminal is the agent
Show it
Before: the sidebar has no extension section yet
cmux: clear; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D"; echo "files in the customize folder: $(ls -A "$D" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

steps.title: An agent scaffolds a sidebar extension on the SDK (cmux ext new hello --kind sidebar) and saves it as the customize app; cmux places its section in the manifest's bottom region
cmux: clear; T="$(mktemp -d)"; cmux ext new hello --kind sidebar --dir "$T/hello" && cp -R "$T/hello/cmux-app.json" "$T/hello/dist" "$D/" && perl -pi -e 's#local/hello#local/customize#' "$D/cmux-app.json" && grep -n defaultRegion "$D/cmux-app.json"

steps.title: Read back: the section is open in the sidebar and draws the scaffold
The agent edits the extension's file and saves; the section redraws in place, no restart
cmux: clear; perl -pi -e 's/\x60Clicked /\x60Edited by an agent, clicked /' "$D/dist/main.js"; grep -c 'Edited by an agent' "$D/dist/main.js"

steps.title: Read back the live edit

contains: Edited by an agent, clicked 0 times

steps.title: cmux ext reload customize: read the folder again on request; the section reruns in place
Read back after the reload: same section, same place

contains: Edited by an agent, clicked 0 times

steps.title: A save that does not load: the last good view stays and cmux ext reload names the file and line
cmux: clear; printf 'const a b = 2\n' >> "$D/dist/main.js"; cmux ext reload customize; echo exit=$?

steps.title: Read back: still the last good view

contains: Edited by an agent, clicked 0 times

steps.title: The fix: drop the bad line; cmux reload-config reloads settings, the Ghostty config and every local extension
cmux: clear; perl -ni -e 'print unless /^const a b/' "$D/dist/main.js"; cmux reload-config

steps.title: Read back after reload-config

contains: Edited by an agent, clicked 0 times

steps.title: Variant: a list section (Row nodes) the agent writes
cmux: cat > "$D/dist/main.js" <<'JS'function renderSection() {  return VStack({ spacing: 0 }, [    Row({ title: 'cmux ext new --kind sidebar', subtitle: 'merged', symbol: 'arrow.triangle.pull', badge: 2 }),    Row({ title: 'Extension SDK 1.0', subtitle: 'merged', symbol: 'shippingbox' }),    Row({ title: 'Sections reload on request', subtitle: 'CI running', symbol: 'arrow.clockwise', tint: 'accent' }),  ])}globalThis.__cmuxAppExports = { renderSection }JSperl -pi -e 's/"title": "Hello"/"title": "Recent PRs"/' "$D/cmux-app.json"; clear; cmux ext reload customize
